metadata.title: Порядок здійснення фармаконагляду, затверджений наказом МОЗ України від 03 червня 2026 року № 740 (Procedure for pharmacovigilance approved by MOH Order No. 740)
metadata.edition: Order of 03.06.2026, registered by the Ministry of Justice 23.07.2026 No. 1061/46455 · replaces Order No. 898; in force 1 January 2027 with Law No. 2469-IX (date from an unofficial report; verify) · Section V: 15 and 90 calendar days, foreign fatal or life-threatening unexpected 15, PSUR 70/90 (Ukrainian)
metadata.legal_basis: Ministry of Health order registered with the Ministry of Justice (No. 1061/46455); the official Ukrainian text governs.
